info.title: Mage API
info.description: Run Mage models from your own code: submit a generation, poll its status, download the result. Every request is paid in gems.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: What the API can generate with.

tags.name: Characters
tags.description: Saved characters a prompt mentions by `@handle`.

tags.name: References
tags.description: Saved image and audio references a prompt mentions by `@handle`.

post.description: Submit a generation with any architecture.

parameters.name: architecture
parameters.description: The architecture id, from the catalog.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of your choosing, 1 to 255 characters, scoped to your API key. A retried submit with the same key returns the original request with `200` instead of charging again. The key identifies the first submission made with it; later bodies are not compared. A refusal recorded under the key (its envelope carries `request_id`) replays the same way, so a new attempt needs a new key.

requestBody.description: A partial config for the architecture.

example.prompt: Editorial portrait in soft daylight, 35mm film look

202.description: The request was accepted; poll `status_url` for the result. A retried submit whose `Idempotency-Key` was used before answers `200` with the same shape, the original request, and charges nothing.

error.message: Unknown architecture `fluxx`. List architectures at GET /v1/architectures.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
Python SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
from mage_space import Mage

mage = Mage()  # reads MAGE_API_KEY

request = mage.generate("mango", {
    "prompt": "Editorial portrait in soft daylight, 35mm film look",
    "aspect_ratio": "4:5",
})

print(request["request_id"], request["status"])

get.description: Every architecture the API can generate with, with its fields, tokens, defaults, and price.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
Python SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
from mage_space import Mage

mage = Mage()  # reads MAGE_API_KEY

catalog = mage.architectures.list()

for architecture in catalog["architectures"]:
    print(architecture["id"], architecture["gems"])

get.description: The state, result, and billing of a request.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: The `request_id` from the submit response.

error.message: The generation failed. Any gems charged were refunded.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
Python SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
from mage_space import Mage

mage = Mage()  # reads MAGE_API_KEY

request = mage.requests.get("REQUEST_ID")

# Or poll until it is completed, failed, or cancelled:
final = mage.requests.wait("REQUEST_ID")
print(final["status"], final["result"] and final["result"]["url"])

post.description: Stop a live request. Gems are not refunded.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: The `request_id` from the submit response.

200.description: The request's state after the cancellation.

error.message: The request has already finished and cannot be cancelled.

error.message: `content_type` must be one of: image/jpeg, image/png, video/mp4, video/quicktime, video/webm, audio/mpeg, audio/mp3, audio/wav, audio/wave, audio/x-wav.

get.description: The account's own characters, newest first. Other users' public characters are not listed; they are reached by `@handle` in a prompt.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Entities per page, 1 to 200; 50 when omitted.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page.

data.name: Ana
data.description: A red-haired courier in a green jacket.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
Python SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
from mage_space import Mage

mage = Mage()  # reads MAGE_API_KEY

page = mage.characters.list(limit=50)

for character in page["data"]:
    print(f"@{character['handle']}", character["name"])
# Pass page["next_cursor"] as cursor for the next page.

post.description: Save a private character from a name, a portrait, and optionally a voice clip. Its `handle` is what a prompt mentions.

example.description: A red-haired courier in a green jacket.

mage = Mage()  # reads MAGE_API_KEY

mage.characters.create(
    name="Ana",
    handle="ana",
    image="https://example.com/ana.jpg",
)

mage.run("mango", {"prompt": "@ana walking through a night market"})

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of your choosing, 1 to 255 characters, scoped to your API key. A retried submit with the same key returns the original request with `200` instead of charging again. The key identifies the first submission made with it; later bodies are not compared. A refusal recorded under the key (its envelope carries `request_id`) replays the same way, so a new attempt needs a new key.

seed.description: Integer seed for reproducible output; omit or send null for a random seed.
